title: WS-3: Restore one reproducible green MAP baseline
description: Child of TASK-309, gated on TASK-311. Reproduce and resolve the approved recovery baseline failures without broad refactoring: separate environmental fixture limitations from product defects, repair truthful stale assertions and invalid active evidence, and publish one canonical command plus result. Do not begin active-core moves or new subsystem work.
acceptance_criteria: A single documented baseline command runs in the declared environment and passes, or each remaining non-product environmental limitation is independently demonstrated and isolated.
The baseline addresses the seven captured failures, including collision checks, invalid herdr evidence, new event warnings, TASK-294 stale assertions, and the Layer1 derivative.
No unrelated user changes are overwritten and every code or evidence change has a focused regression test or validator.
A different core agent independently reproduces the final baseline before approval.
